integrity: The universal theorem is analytic. The bundled finite computation is a consistency replay only and is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats ordinary complex irreducible representations of finite dihedral groups. It does not classify reducible or projective representations. A later 2025 paper on phase retrievability of irreducible finite-group representations was identifiable bibliographically but not materially readable in the inspected sources, leaving a residual priority risk.
title: Exact maximal-spanning vectors for two-dimensional dihedral irreducibles
